```{python}
#| label: fig-constraint-domain
#| fig-cap: "Constraint application over a 2-field domain space. Each step applies a constraint, removing invalid combinations. The remaining space shrinks until only valid encodings survive."
#| fig-alt: "Six-panel animation showing constraint application as valid regions (green) shrinking from the full domain to the final valid set."
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
from matplotlib.animation import FuncAnimation
from IPython.display import HTML

np.random.seed(42)

# Domain: field_a [0,15], field_b [0,15]
N = 16
domain = np.ones((N, N), dtype=bool)

# Constraints:
# 1. field_a even
c1 = np.zeros((N, N), dtype=bool)
c1[0::2, :] = True
# 2. field_b range [3, 12]
c2 = np.zeros((N, N), dtype=bool)
c2[:, 3:13] = True
# 3. field_a != field_b (neq)
c3 = np.eye(N, dtype=bool) == False  # all True except diagonal

constraints = [c1, c2, c3]
labels = [
    "Constraint 1: field_a ∈ even",
    "Constraint 2: field_b ∈ [3, 12]",
    "Constraint 3: field_a ≠ field_b",
]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(12, 8))
axes = axes.flatten()

current = np.ones((N, N), dtype=bool)

for i, (ax, constraint, label) in enumerate(zip(axes, constraints, labels)):
    current = current & constraint

    ax.imshow(current, cmap='RdYlGn', vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect='equal',
              interpolation='nearest', extent=[-0.5, N-0.5, N-0.5, -0.5])

    for (r, c) in zip(*np.where(current)):
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((c-0.5, r-0.5), 1, 1, fill=False,
                                edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.3, alpha=0.3))

    ax.set_xticks(range(N))
    ax.set_yticks(range(N))
    ax.set_xlabel("field_a")
    ax.set_ylabel("field_b")
    ax.set_title(label, fontsize=9)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=6)

title_prefix = "Step 1: Full domain"
ax = axes[0]
ax.set_title("Step 0: Full domain\n(all 256 combinations)", fontsize=9)

valid_count = np.sum(current)
ax = axes[-1]
ax.set_title(f"Final: {valid_count} valid\n(out of 256)", fontsize=9, color='green' if valid_count > 0 else 'red')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
